programme_facts.value: Admissions in the Biomedical Science certificate courses are not done in a properly organized manner.
No particular entrance exams are conducted for admission in Biomedical Science certificate courses.
Enrollment in online certificate Biomedical Science courses is simply done by applying on the website of the course provider.
In the case of offline certificate Biomedical Science courses, Institutes might enroll you on first come first serve.
Admission for diploma Biomedical Science courses is solely done based on merit.
A candidate should have completed class 12th or 10th (as applicable) from a recognized board.
A student should have obtained 50% marks with science and mathematics as compulsory subjects to get a diploma in biomedical engineering course.
Admission is done through merit score.
Students have to fill the application form and upon successful registration, the counseling process is conducted for the candidates.
A candidate must have passed class 12th or any other equivalent examination with physics, chemistry, and biology as compulsory subjects from a recognized board.
A student must have secured the minimum required percentage in PCB collectively to get admission.

Students who wish to pursue further studies in Biomedical Sciences after completion of their Bachelor's degree can do so through a Master of Science (M.Sc) in the subject. Admissions into M.Sc. Biomedical Science courses are conducted either based on merit or with the help of entrance exams.

While there are no common entrance exams, most colleges offer admission based on their performance in graduation. The remaining few institutes prefer to conduct their entrance examinations as part of the screening process during admissions.
